content_sections.heading: NPCIL Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the NPCIL Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download NPCIL Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: NPCIL Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 3 vacancies are available - 1 for Fixed Term Medical Officer/E (Paediatrician), 1 for Fixed Term Medical Officer/E (Dental Surgeon), and 1 for Fixed Term GDMO.

content_sections.heading: NPCIL Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Fixed Term Medical Officer/E (Paediatrician): MS/MD or equivalent from a recognised university in the concerned specialty with 4 years of relevant experience after obtaining requisite qualification OR MBBS + relevant PG Diploma or equivalent from a recognised university in the concerned specialty with 8 years of relevant experience after obtaining requisite qualification. Fixed Term Medical Officer/E (Dental Surgeon): MDS – Prosthodontist from a recognised University and minimum experience of 03 years post MDS. Fixed Term GDMO: MBBS + relevant PG Diploma including DRM or equivalent from a recognized University OR MBBS from a recognized University + one year post qualification relevant experience.

content_sections.heading: NPCIL Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Minimum Age: 18 years Maximum Age: 45 years Age Relaxation: 10 years for PwBD; age relaxation without upper limit for spouse of NPCIL employees at NPCIL Sites. To avoid any confusion regarding age eligibility, candidates can use our Age Calculator to calculate their exact age based on the prescribed cut-off date before applying.

content_sections.heading: NPCIL Recruitment 2026 - Salary
content_sections.text: Fixed Term Medical Officer/E (Paediatrician): ₹1,76,500/- Per Month Fixed Term Medical Officer/E (Dental Surgeon): ₹1,76,500/- Per Month Fixed Term GDMO: ₹1,27,000/- Per Month

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for NPCIL Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for NPCIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the NPCIL Recruitment 2026 is scheduled to be held on 25th August 2026. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in the NPCIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies announced for the Fixed Term Medical Officer/E (Paediatrician), Fixed Term Medical Officer/E (Dental Surgeon), and Fixed Term GDMO posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Fixed Term GDMO post?
faq.answer: For the Fixed Term GDMO post, candidates need to have an MBBS degree with a relevant PG Diploma or one year of post-qualification relevant experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applying to the NPCIL posts?
faq.answer: The minimum age limit is 18 years, and the maximum age limit is 45 years for all the posts announced under this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for NPCIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Fixed Term Medical Officer/E posts?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Fixed Term Medical Officer/E (Paediatrician) and Fixed Term Medical Officer/E (Dental Surgeon) posts is ₹1,76,500/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for NPCIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process for the NPCIL Recruitment 2026 will be based on a Personal Interview. Candidates need to perform well in the interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the walk-in interview for NPCIL Recruitment 2026 going to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at Narora, Uttar Pradesh, with the pincode 203389. The exact venue details will be in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, and category certificates (if applicable).

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, this is a contractual job. The posts are advertised as Fixed Term positions, indicating a contractual employment basis.
